mandatoryCriteria: Board listing: GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/boards returns active boards for granted project members; ungranted users receive 404 NOT_FOUND
Board update: PATCH /api/v1/boards/:boardId updates board name when called by owner or manager; members/viewers receive 403 FORBIDDEN
Optimistic concurrency: PATCH /api/v1/boards/:boardId verifies expectedVersion matches current snapshot_version; returns 409 STALE_VERSION on conflict
Idempotency enforcement: PATCH /api/v1/boards/:boardId requires Idempotency-Key header
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Board listing and renaming with OCC.
